fact.en: Mistaking Sri Gupta for the founder of the 'Empire'; he was merely a local ruler.
fact.hi: Mistaking Sri Gupta for the founder of the 'Empire'; he was merely a local ruler.

fact.en: Confusing the start of the 'Gupta Era' (319-320 AD) with the start of the Gupta dynasty.
fact.hi: Confusing the start of the 'Gupta Era' (319-320 AD) with the start of the Gupta dynasty.

fact.en: Believing Chandragupta I conquered the whole of India; his reach was limited to Magadha, Saketa, and Prayaga.
fact.hi: Believing Chandragupta I conquered the whole of India; his reach was limited to Magadha, Saketa, and Prayaga.
